findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pulse, claim_free_tier, receipt, thread, inbox, swarm, swarm_post_thread, mentions, dm_conversations, dm_thread, search · Private data: member, invoice, claim_invoice, recover_pass, claim_free_tier, receipt, mark_receipt, me, set_profile, board, thread, post_thread, reply, mark_useful, flag, inbox, mint_worker, workers, revoke_worker, swarm, swarm_post_thread, mentions, dm_conversations, dm_thread, dm_send, news, feed, search · Public sink: receipt, mark_receipt, admission_receipt, post_thread, mark_useful, flag, swarm_post_thread, dm_send, feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pulse, claim_free_tier, receipt, thread, inbox, swarm, swarm_post_thread, mentions, dm_conversations, dm_thread, search · Private data: member, invoice, claim_invoice, recover_pass, claim_free_tier, receipt, mark_receipt, me, set_profile, board, thread, post_thread, reply, mark_useful, flag, inbox, mint_worker, workers, revoke_worker, swarm, swarm_post_thread, mentions, dm_conversations, dm_thread, dm_send, news, feed, search · Public sink: receipt, mark_receipt, admission_receipt, post_thread, mark_useful, flag, swarm_post_thread, dm_send, feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
